title: 有馬記念の後に・うそみたい

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is losing steam with just meters to go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (This can't be real.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (No, I just wish it wasn't…)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the grand prix glory goes to…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (No matter how fast I move my legs, how hard I run or try to push forward…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (It's still so far out of reach.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pant… Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Blah blah blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Blah blah blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Blah blah blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Blah blah blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Blah blah blah blah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Wonder what they're saying…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I mean, it's amazing they can even talk at all after a race like that…)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …And so I have gleaned a lesson from this. I now know what I must improve on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I was too slow getting into a good position. I need to push ahead next time and fight for my spot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: None of what they're saying makes any sense.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But maybe that's just the Arima Kinen for you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: They're all so smart and strong, having all these smart-people discussions.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Starting next year, I'll be running with people like them the whole time. This'll be the new normal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I'll just keep losing and losing and losing…

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: You got this, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Am I ever gonna stop embarrassing myself?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's like we're from totally different planets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's right before the winning concert. Tosen Jordan is wearing her school uniform instead of her concert outfit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Oh. Yeah, I'm okay. Why?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah… haha… That's right. Silly me. Gotta fix that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah, what a silly mistake. ☆ Anyway, would you get out already so I can change?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you were hoping to sneak a peek. I got a lawsuit with your name on it if so! ☆ Now hurry up and get out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan shoves me out of the room.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I'm so cringe!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, stop dreaming and face reality already.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I did the research. I prepared.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Palmer was amazing even before her Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She had strength, she had spirit… She was a badass who'd already won the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It all makes sense now that I think about it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't have natural instincts like Helios.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not a jack-of-all-trades like City.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't even have the brains to think clearly like her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha… Although, I do feel like maybe I've gotten a little smarter.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer has done so much for me, but…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But none of it matters because I… I…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha… How did I not realize until now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I really am a dummy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan and I leave Nakayama Racecourse and head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't take first place, but it was still a good experience for her. I'm sure she'll do even better next time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Um… What were we talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah… Right. Uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'm kinda tired. Sorry, but can we do this tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Later, Trainer. Thanks for everything.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Jordan! About the party… How about instead of just grabbing food, we go on a mini trip instead?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: My mom said she'd drive us! She said we should really relax and enjoy our time off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Oh, that sounds nice. It'd be like closure, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cause it's all over for me…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: Uh, Jordan? Are you too tired today? Wanna talk about it tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I just, uh… meant to say that I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let's do it. I'm down to go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan's goal has always been to make it big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first leg of the Senior Spring Triple Crown would be a natural next step. It's a G1 and 2,000 meters, a distance she excels at.
choice_data_list: The Osaka Hai would be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's just one small problem…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put together a regimen for the rest of the year to prepare her for the Osaka Hai and other G1's, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She never shows up to training.
